text:
mina: Quick sync  ops reported confusion when auto-fallbacks show up in the console as "changed model" with no context. We need a compact UX spec: what info lives in the header pill vs the detail timeline?

jorge: header pill only: mode (auto-fallback), fallback model name, short trigger tag (e.g., infra_5xx), and TTL timer. clicking opens timeline. avoid banners.

alin: timeline should show: trigger snapshot (metric, value, threshold), percent routed, who (system or user), and an 'Undo' CTA if RBAC allows. include a CSV export link.

infra-bot: infra-bot: event -> rollout 6112223334 triggered at 6112223338 (trigger=p95_latency_ms>1200). routed 40/400 to cheaper-quant-v1. logs -> https://logs/rollouts/6112223334

tia: telemetry ask: always emit an audit event for simulated runs too (field simulated=true). sampling of inputs must be per-rollout opt-in. when on, store salted hash only.

mina: API parity: POST /rollouts/{id}/actions { action: "undo", note: "string", simulate: false } returns op id and emits audit. add GET /rollouts/{id}/audit for CSV.

jorge: also add a cooldown parameter in policy so we don't flip-flop. default 120s. show cooldown remaining in timeline entries.

alin: privacy: sampled inputs truncated, and enterprise tenants default to capture=false. show a clear warning in the modal if capture enabled.

mina: owners: @jorge header/timeline UI, @alin API + privacy, @tia telemetry. I'll draft a tiny mock and attach to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
